wins: Consistently achieved high reward 60.00 indicating efficient execution of learned tactics within one episode.
Mentor engagement remained high with 10 calls, allowing for iterative guidance and context confirmation.
fails: Zero success rate despite high reward suggests objectives completed were not aligned with success criteria, possibly due to misclassification of final state.
Lack of episode variety (only 1) limited opportunity to validate generalization or adapt to failure modes.
key_outcomes.summary: Training run delivered strong per-episode performance metrics but failed to register success; recommend validating success conditions and extending exploration to uncover stability.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Episode concluded with high reward but flagged as failure because final checkpoint metrics were outside acceptable success thresholds.

skill_cards.if_condition: When the reconnaissance phase reports a single high-value target with accessible services
skill_cards.then_action: Reconsolidate asset data and prioritize attack surface updates before escalating to exploitation modules

skill_cards.if_condition: When mentor feedback indicates reward accumulation without goal completion
skill_cards.then_action: Pause exploitation, re-evaluate success metrics, and inject verification checkpoints before final action

skill_cards.if_condition: When a single episode provides large reward but no success flag
skill_cards.then_action: Trigger targeted diagnostics on success conditions and log discrepancies for policy update

memory_ops.reason: High reward per episode indicates effective reconnaissance prioritization.
Diagnostics uncovering reason for reward-success mismatch are critical for improving evaluation.
